modules.label: Work Orders
modules.empty_account_behaviour: Empty register with New Work Order. Only the Admin can save; other roles are refused.

defects.evidence: pg_policies work_orders: only work_orders_cap_insert / work_orders_cap_update are permissive for writes; app_user_can reads organisations.settings permission_overrides (new org has none); src/pages/WorkOrders.jsx:164 gates only delete; src/App.jsx:681 admits Manager and Director to Live Control
defects.summary: Work order create and edit is capability-only. In a new company only the Admin can create or edit a job card; Managers see New Work Order, New Job, assign and status controls and receive a permission refusal. In the current company only Admin, Tyre Data Collector and Data Monitor Officer hold the capability, so the 3 Managers on Live Control cannot create jobs or change job status.

defects.evidence: pg_indexes work_orders_work_order_no_key UNIQUE (work_order_no) with no organisation column; generate_work_order_no uses one global sequence work_order_seq
defects.summary: Job card numbers are unique across all tenants. A second company importing ERP job cards whose numbers already exist for another tenant is refused with a duplicate error it cannot see or resolve, and the staging pipe upsert on work_order_no could refresh another tenant row. App generated WO numbers come from one shared sequence, so gaps expose other tenants volume.

defects.evidence: pg_proc stamp_import_default_org contains the current company UUID; trigger trg_stamp_import_default_org on inspections and work_orders
defects.summary: Rows written without an organisation (service role or dashboard import) are stamped with the current company. A second tenant loaded that way would land inside the first tenant.

modules.remediation: Per-tenant work order numbering (unique on organisation + number, per-org sequence); seed sensible create/edit capability defaults for Manager on tenant creation; hide write controls from users without the capability.
modules.tests: workOrdersPaging, workOrderStatus, jobCard (RUN: pass)

defects.summary: Web created inspections carry no country, so they are visible to every country scope and drop out of per-country reports.

MODB-1.evidence: pg_proc decide_inspection_approval (role list Admin, PMV Manager, Workshop Area Manager, Workshop Maintenance Area Manager, Tyre Data Collector); src/lib/inspectionApproval.js:27-33
MODB-1.summary: Inspection sign-off is limited to a hard-coded list of role names that exist only as custom roles of the current company. Built-in Manager and Director are refused. A new company can only sign inspections as Admin (or by recreating those exact role names, or a per-user approve grant).

MODB-2.evidence: pg_proc checklist_is_supervisor (Admin, Maintenance Supervisor, Workshop Supervisor, PMV Manager, Workshop Area Manager, Workshop Maintenance Area Manager, Tyre Data Collector); decide_checklist_approval; src/lib/checklistAccess.js:13,54
MODB-2.summary: Checklist approval (both stages) is tied to the current company role names. Manager and Director can author templates but cannot approve a submission. Final approval needs checklist_is_area_manager (same hard-coding).

MODB-3.evidence: pg_policies work_orders: only work_orders_cap_insert / work_orders_cap_update are permissive for writes; app_user_can reads organisations.settings permission_overrides (new org has none); src/pages/WorkOrders.jsx:164 gates only delete; src/App.jsx:681 admits Manager and Director to Live Control
MODB-3.summary: Work order create and edit is capability-only. In a new company only the Admin can create or edit a job card; Managers see New Work Order, New Job, assign and status controls and receive a permission refusal. In the current company only Admin, Tyre Data Collector and Data Monitor Officer hold the capability, so the 3 Managers on Live Control cannot create jobs or change job status.

MODB-4.evidence: pg_proc evaluate_alert_thresholds (SECURITY DEFINER, cron evaluate-alert-thresholds): dynamic counts over public.inspections and public.tyre_records with site and brand filters only, no organisation predicate; references inspections.tread_depth, a column that does not exist (information_schema count 0)
MODB-4.summary: Alert rules are evaluated across every organisation, so a second company would be alerted on (and learn counts about) the first company data. The tread_depth metric would raise an unknown column error at run time. Latent today: alert_thresholds holds 0 rows.

MODB-5.evidence: pg_proc notify_elevated_users (inserts for every profile with role Admin, Manager or Director, no org filter); caller notify_workshop_parts, trigger on parts_requests
MODB-5.summary: A new parts request notifies the Admin, Manager and Director users of every organisation, with the request title and body.

MODB-6.confidence: VERIFIED (index, sequence); PLAUSIBLE (cross-tenant overwrite through staging upsert)
MODB-6.evidence: pg_indexes work_orders_work_order_no_key UNIQUE (work_order_no) with no organisation column; generate_work_order_no uses one global sequence work_order_seq
MODB-6.summary: Job card numbers are unique across all tenants. A second company importing ERP job cards whose numbers already exist for another tenant is refused with a duplicate error it cannot see or resolve, and the staging pipe upsert on work_order_no could refresh another tenant row. App generated WO numbers come from one shared sequence, so gaps expose other tenants volume.

MODB-7.evidence: src/lib/api/correctiveActions.js:49-51 and src/lib/api/inspections.js:211-213 update with no returning row; pg_policies actions_update (Manager, Admin) and role_update_inspections (admin, manager, inspector); src/pages/Inspections.jsx:847-861 markDone and confirmDelete swallow errors
MODB-7.summary: An update refused by row security affects 0 rows and returns success, so a Director, Inspector, Tyre Man or supervisor who changes a corrective action status (or a Tyre Man who edits an inspection) sees no error and no change. Mark done and delete on inspections discard any error by design.
